title: A Category-Theoretic Framework from Biological Mechanics to Engineered Stimulus-Response Systems
summary: Natural materials achieve adaptive behavior through hierarchical organization and coupled mechanisms across scales. Their translation into engineering, however, remains largely heuristic. What is missing is a formal translation framework that carries biological design logic into engineered realization while preserving physical consistency across levels of abstraction. Here we present a category theoretic compositional framework for verified nature-derived design.
